scope: logic simulation only; module-level stream engine; no synthesis/Vivado/board/VNC/push; no full model

bp1_both_random.desc: a16_ready and a16_packed_ready driven by independent LFSR bits

bp5_packed_long_stall.desc: a16_ready=1; packed ready only in last 32 of every 256 cycles (224-cycle stall)

constants.dependency_set: primary_stream_fix/candidate (gemini_fma_round2 SHA); held identical for both DUTs
constants.compile: iverilog -g2012, one variant at a time (no parallel jobs)
constants.correctness_gate: rc==0 AND milestone present AND A16/packed data, tag, last and counts all exact; any failure => comparison invalid, no speedup claim
constants.param_passing: PARAM_EN/PARAM_ADDR/PARAM_DATA are actually passed to vvp; bias-only test uses them

bias_only.expected_semantics: scale falls back to cfg_scale=1.5; preloaded bias=2.0
bias_only.note: Old/gemini version writes bias only but sets a shared param_loaded flag, so uninitialised param_mem[0] is used as scale. Failure is recorded; its cycles are NOT reported as an acceleration.
